identity.seed: Laid by the exact solver (exact-rota.py) with every rest day chosen again. It started from Short Openers' rest days, on which these duties leave one rest under 14h 20m (whoever works the Sunday 09:00-18:00 is back at 07:30 on Monday), freed the early weeks' rest days to clear it, and then let the whole rota move. Held throughout: every week all earlies or all lates, no 55-hour week with the cover weeks placed every way (H55=3300), a shortest rest of 14h 20m, 14 days' leave buying 30 days off and at worst 20, four weeks off for 14 days' leave or less, at most 6 single rest days in 26 weeks, no week over 42h 55m and at most 10 shifts between two-day breaks. Then the most weeks on one shift time, and the smallest week-to-week change of start. FIX= checks this grid against that model; the commands are in exact-rota.py's header
